title: How Dutch made Arthur Morgan an outlaw in Red Dead 2
subject: arthur
description:
Would you have followed Dutch? 👇

How a lost boy named Arthur Morgan became Dutch van der Linde's most loyal man. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

scenes.text: Arthur Morgan was a teenager when an outlaw became his father.
His mother died when he was small, and his real father, Lyle, was a petty criminal.
Then, around 1877, Dutch van der Linde and Hosea Matthews took him in.
Hosea taught him the con. Dutch gave him a dream: living free, outside the law.
But that's not the worst part. Arthur believed every word for over twenty years.
By 1899, the gang was collapsing, and Dutch's dream was quietly becoming a trap.
